marketplace.policy: Do not promote a financial provider or claim referral economics until capi2 is formally approved and an official tracked arrangement is active. Regulated execution remains with licensed/authorized providers.

partners.name: Wise
partners.permitted_economics: Commission for each new referred user; potentially higher commission for large-transfer and business referrals; exact rate is program/region specific and not yet approved for capi2.
constraints: Commercial promotion requires an approved partner/invite program and tracking link.
No paid advertising without explicit prior written consent under Wise partner guidelines.
capi2 remains referral/software routing only and does not execute or custody payments.

partners.name: Airwallex
partners.permitted_economics: Commission on each qualified new customer referral; tailored commission after application approval; tracking/reporting/payouts handled through the approved partner channel.
constraints: Membership is subject to Airwallex approval.
No commission claim or tracked referral until formal approval.
capi2 does not execute or custody payments or FX.

partners.name: Alpaca Europe
partners.permitted_economics: No public referral commission rate verified; commercial terms require a direct sales/partner agreement.
constraints: Alpaca Europe performs regulated brokerage functions under its applicable EU framework.
capi2 must not place trades, custody assets, give personalized investment advice, or represent itself as a broker.
Any regulated onboarding/execution step must remain with Alpaca Europe or another authorized provider.

partners.name: Qover
partners.permitted_economics: Qover may remunerate Business Introducers and other intermediaries by commission or other economic benefit; exact capi2 economics are not approved.
constraints: Business Introducer activity remains lead-generation/generic-information only unless a licensed or exempt distribution role is formally established.
Qover remains the regulated insurance intermediary/distribution layer.
capi2 must not sell insurance, collect premiums, underwrite, bind cover, or give personalized regulated insurance advice.

marketplace_routes.name: PayAPI Market
marketplace_routes.economics: Listing is free; providers keep 100% of buyer payment on PayAPI Market.
requirements: Public URL callable without login or Vercel protection.
x402 on the route: HTTP 402, price in USDC on Base, payTo set to capi2 wallet.
Submit via PayAPI Market normal listing form with wallet, price and public base URL.
After free checks, PayAPI Market may run one small paid verification test.
